|errata_history=This is the original printing, represented by the matching printed face in the August 2025 release sheet. It is not the current version; the current text is [[Vicrul (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image in the repository revision of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-vi-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/vicrul.gif vicrul.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. If you just initiated a Force drain here, may place topmost Interrupt of opponent's Lost Pile out of play.”
*: This version's card image was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 2, file created 10 August 2025, with the same words ([[:File:V25-D-vicrul-2025-08-10-sheet-slip.png|slip]]); the slip prints no errata mark. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and the card image are one version, on this page.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Vicrul (Errata)]]): PC card image in the repository revision of 12 December 2025<ref name="ht-vi-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/vicrul.gif vicrul.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e 5637ac6] (12 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: an art credit (“Image courtesy of Matthew Cohen @ Instagram”) is added along the left edge. Game text unchanged. Text: “[Pilot] 2. Power +1 for each opponent's card out of play. Opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have Kylo or a Knight of Ren. If you just initiated a Force drain here, may place topmost Interrupt of opponent's Lost Pile out of play.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
